description: This file defines the 'LoanDelinquencyActionRepository' interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces to provide data access methods for 'LoanDelinquencyAction' entities, including custom query methods relevant to loan delinquency actions.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyActionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing LoanDelinquencyAction entities, providing database operations including custom query for effective delinquency actions.

methods.name: getEffectiveDelinquencyActionForLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the effective delinquency actions for a specific loan as of a given business date, considering pause and resume actions.

methods.name: findByLoanOrderById
methods.description: Finds all LoanDelinquencyActions for a given loan, ordered by their ID.
